//: Pin for the bundled FFmpeg build (SPEC §2/§11: fetch a pinned encoder build,
verify against a committed checksum, record the exact upstream build identifier).
This pins the GPL variant DELIBERATELY — a recorded decision, not a mistake:
this deployment is internal-only (nothing is conveyed outside the organisation),
and the GPL build carries libx264, whose true CRF mode gives the software
fallback constant-quality encoding on machines without a working GPU encoder
(see docs/developer-guide/design-decisions.md). If this app is ever distributed
outside the organisation, repoint at the -lgpl asset of the same tag and drop
libx264 from optionalEncoders — the encoder trial system degrades gracefully.
To upgrade: pick a dated autobuild tag from github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases,
copy the asset's line from its checksums.sha256, update this file, and re-run
build/fetch-ffmpeg.ps1 — it fails hard on any mismatch.
